top_choice_rationale: Base editing is a mature-enough, reproduced chemical invention: a deaminase directed to a programmed base without double-strand cleavage, separable from the 2020 scissors prize. The cytosine editor (Komor, Liu) and the adenine editor (Gaudelli, Liu, with a TadA evolved to act on DNA) are distinct inventive steps, so Liu, Komor and Gaudelli match the experimental lineage within the three-laureate limit, and no second part is added merely to fill the prize. P001 is next because it keeps base editing and adds sequencing by synthesis, a mature achievement, though the Liu-only attribution and the Rothberg and Mayer lineage are unresolved.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I am a Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, whose preferred proposal is P005 (ranked low on scientific grounds), and none of the credited laureates are connected to my field
